sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A vigorous perennial vine native to tropical and subtropical America, climbing to about 10 m. It is also naturalized in other tropical regions.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: The heart-shaped leaves are about 5–15 × 4–14 cm. Fragrant white flowers open at night and reach 11–16 cm across; the capsule is about 2.5–3 cm long.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No specific reliable food use is established in the sources consulted.
